name: memail_thread
description: Read a whole conversation. Pass a `thread_id` (found on any message from memail_list / memail_search / memail_get) to get every cached message in that thread, oldest first — same summary shape as memail_list ({ thread_id, messages: [...] }, no bodies). Use it to see the back-and-forth around a message before summarizing or replying context; fetch individual bodies with memail_get as needed.
